title: Text: DET Dan Griesbaum ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: If I were to write a column about September approaching and ideas to get more people here, what’s realistic and not?
Like, kids under 12 free....free admission after fifth inning... something to give back to the fans for a good taste heading into 2020 would be my hook
And what are these orange cards people are putting in random seats?

Kids free is a nice idea but the problem is that you are basically saying any person can be free because you can’t ask for proof of age as someone is walking in.  So, people will either take advantage or they will assume you don’t care and just want to get bodies in there (which isn’t that awful). Free after 5th inning is ok but the problem with these types of ideas is that they are always looked upon w scorn by the current Season tickets holders that are getting killed on their investment already.  I believe they have an idea going already for the final game on Sept 26- very cheap group tickets (15 people or more usually)- $10 and less in the vast majority of uppers. The orange cards direct people to claim a prize. When the prize is claimed they are also given a pitch on 2020 season packages.  I believe seats are targeted that are not already season seats.
So that’s not allowed, to check IDs or is what you’re saying like, 12 y/os don’t have IDs

Right and even if you could it would slow things up too much. It’s not worth doing. There is some precedent for this since 3 and younger are free, but they also don’t get a seat or utilize a ticket at all.
